name: Easynews Player
subtitle: Usenet search with a real codec stack

apps.name: Easynews Player
apps.subtitle: Search Easynews, play anything
apps.localizedDescription: Search Easynews and stream results with VLC's decoder. Plays MKV, HEVC, AV1, AC3, E-AC3 and DTS natively, none of which AVPlayer supports. Files stream over HTTPS range requests, so seeking works without downloading first.
